summary: Per second on measured CPU with a 50-millicore floor, reserved memory, and stored disk in decimal GB.

plans.name: Prepaid credit
plans.note: An account that has bought credit gets 25 active vCPU-hours and 100 GiB-hours of memory free every calendar month; the calculator takes them off first. A new account's one-time free hours are separate and not counted here.

notes: A stopped box keeps billing storage, including saved memory; only delete ends the charge.
Automatic top-ups earn 5% extra credit, not subtracted here.
Storage is $0.08 per decimal GB per 30-day month, so the hourly rate divides by 720 hours. Runtime rounds its own per-GiB-hour figure to 119 microdollars, which this model does not reproduce exactly.

upkeep.label: What you keep up
upkeep.detail: When Runtime updates its default image, a paused sandbox or snapshot keeps its old files; only new sandboxes get the update. You run apt yourself.

source.quote: An existing paused sandbox or snapshot keeps the filesystem saved with its memory. Updating Runtime's default image does not replace those files.
